q2_gaps: a definite plural DIRECT OBJECT of a distributive predicate ('drains the lanterns'): the per-member distribution rule (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) ...) is specified only for a group in the acting-subject role (and, separately, for a resultative's flat half), so the instruction set never says whether a group filling Patient / Theme also hands the predication down to its members
notes: 'the West Row' is correctly a proper noun (capitalized run exceeds the bare class word) as one opaque symbol with its Name string plus a separate kind atom and no modifier genus, and the definite plural correctly takes a group witness predicated as a unit. Whether 'the lanterns of the West Row' is part-whole (PartOf) rather than the opaque Possession is a genuine coin-flip under the section's single test, and the opaque fallback is defensible.
